name.zh: 2027年美墨加協定年度聯合檢討

city.en: To be announced (trilateral Free Trade Commission)
city.zh: 待公布（三國自由貿易委員會）

next_meeting.note: Next joint review due by 1 July 2027; USTR public comments due 12 Jan 2027. Venue not announced.

title.en: US declines to extend USMCA, annual reviews begin
title.zh: 美國未同意延長協定，啟動年度檢討

summary.en: At the July 2026 joint review the US did not confirm a 16-year extension, so the three countries must now review the deal every year; it stays in force meanwhile.
summary.zh: 在2026年7月的聯合檢討中，美國未確認延長16年，三國須每年檢討；協定在此期間仍然有效。

question.en: How does uncertainty about a trade deal's future affect business investment decisions?
question.zh: 貿易協定前景不確定，會如何影響企業的投資決策？

title.zh: 美國貿易代表署為2027年檢討徵求意見

summary.en: In October 2026 USTR opened a public comment period (due 12 January 2027) ahead of the next joint review due by 1 July 2027.
summary.zh: 2026年10月，美國貿易代表署為下一次（2027年7月1日前）聯合檢討開放公眾意見徵詢，截止日為2027年1月12日。

question.en: Which industries would you expect to comment most, and why?
question.zh: 你認為哪些產業最會提出意見？為什麼？

summary.en: A 50% US tariff on about US$20 billion of Canadian imports took effect in August 2026; Canada retaliated in September and the US expanded its measures.
summary.zh: 美國對約200億美元加拿大進口品課徵50%關稅於2026年8月生效；加拿大9月反制，美國隨後擴大措施。

question.en: Can a free trade agreement still work when members impose tariffs on each other under other laws?
question.zh: 當成員國依其他法律互相課稅時，自由貿易協定還能發揮作用嗎？

text.zh: 北美自由貿易協定（NAFTA）生效
美墨加協定於布宜諾斯艾利斯簽署

text.en: Protocol of amendment strengthens labour enforcement
text.zh: 修正議定書強化勞工執法

text.en: First joint review; US declines extension, annual reviews begin
text.zh: 首次聯合檢討；美國未同意延長，改為年度檢討
